newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mark up versus yen, dollar, Aussie stays weak.
newsitem.headline: Mark up versus yen, dollar, Aussie stays weak.

text.p: *Mark rose against yen on speculative buying in line with Tietmeyer remark on Thursday that the mark's level correctly reflected economic fundamentals and that the Bundesbank did not want a weak mark.
*Mark's strength against yen also pushed down dollar against German unit, traders said.
*Institutional investors sold dollars at around 125.70 yen, limiting dollar's upward potential.
*Australian dollar remained weak due to fears that Australian rates may ease again.
